All 25 points passed physics preflight (W=1.6 GeV is safely above the eta+p threshold of 1.4861 GeV). I generated the 3 chunked input files (10+10+5) plus manifest.csv and outcome.json.

One thing worth flagging: "0 to 345 in 25 steps" implies a phi step of 345/24 = 14.375°, which is unusual — a full-circle 15° scan would instead give 24 points, not 25. I generated exactly what was requested but noted this in outcome.json in case you actually wanted the standard 24-point/15° grid.

All 25 points passed physics preflight (W=1.6 GeV is safely above the eta+p threshold of 1.4861 GeV). I generated the 3 chunked input files (10+10+5) plus manifest.csv and outcome.json.

One thing worth flagging: "0 to 345 in 25 steps" implies a phi step of 345/24 = 14.375°, which is unusual — a full-circle 15° scan would instead give 24 points, not 25. I generated exactly what was requested but noted this in outcome.json in case you actually wanted the standard 24-point/15° grid.
